carousel.excerpt: Ramya Anche of the University of Arizona will lead PUFFINS, a $20 million NASA Pioneers mission using a 10-inch ultraviolet telescope to decode interstellar dust from about 70 stars ahead of a 2030 launch.
carousel.image_caption: NASA headquarters. Bengaluru-born astronomer Ramya Anche will lead NASA's PUFFINS mission.
carousel.nri_angle: An Indian-origin early-career astronomer leads a NASA mission, offering a visible role model for Indian and diaspora students in space science.
